waiting_on.subject: ▸ Worker đang sửa doctrine (cell ckf-1). Mình chờ kết quả.

route.rationale: doctrine prose only: leader rule plus its full form

cells.title: Cite the knowledge concept before history
cells.action: Edit three homes, short sentences, no new rule id. (1) packages/bee/LEADER.md: in the CLI-only state bullet, change the end 'docs/history/<feature>/CONTEXT.md holds the locked ones — cite them, never reinterpret them.' so it says history holds the locked ones, cite it for a locked decision and its reason, never reinterpret it, and current behavior is cited from its docs/knowledge concept (D2). In rule block agents-knowledge-before-code add one sentence: the same search comes first when a turn answers how something works, before docs/history is opened for that answer (D2). In rule block agents-verify-before-agreeing, after the Sources sentence, add the source order (D1): a claim about how something works now cites the docs/knowledge concept that holds it, then code file:line; docs/history is cited only for why a decision was made; a decision hit leads to the concept that cites its D-number first. Keep every rule marker line unchanged. (2) skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md, section 'Claim labels and pushback': add a 'Source order' paragraph after 'Claim labels' with the D1 order, the decision-hit step, and a short example that cites a docs/knowledge path for a behavior claim and a docs/history CONTEXT.md D-number for a reason. (3) docs/knowledge/areas/doctrine-layer/router-triage-and-the-agents-md-duplication-boundary.md: extend the spoken line of agents-verify-before-agreeing with the source order, and the spoken line of agents-knowledge-before-code with the how-it-works answer; cite cite-knowledge-first D1/D2, never raw decision ids. Then run .bee/bin/bee dev regen once; it re-renders .bee/LEADER.md and the five rendered copies of routing-and-contracts.md. If regen touches .claude/skills paths that are hub-served aliases, restore them with git restore before commit. Write docs/history/cite-knowledge-first/delivery.md (what changed, proof, known limit: bee decisions search still names no concept, p-eb824507). One commit.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test rule_index_parity --test pointer_integrity --test instruction_laws && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check && .bee/bin/bee onboard --repo-root . --json

truths: the citation rule says a how-it-works claim cites the docs/knowledge concept first and docs/history only for why
the knowledge-first rule covers a turn that answers how something works before docs/history is opened
the LEADER.md history line scopes its cite instruction to the locked decision and its reason
.bee/LEADER.md is byte-equal to packages/bee/LEADER.md after regen

artifacts.substantive: source order in two rule blocks and the scoped history line
Source order paragraph in Claim labels

key_links: Claim labels stays the full form of agents-verify-before-agreeing
the rule index spoken lines match the rule blocks
prohibitions: No hand edit of rendered copies
open_choices: Example paths in the Source order paragraph

cells.title: Check the source-order doctrine edit
cells.action: Checker for ckf-1, no product edits. Run the verify command. Check that packages/bee/LEADER.md and .bee/LEADER.md are byte-equal, that the five rendered copies of skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md carry the Source order paragraph, and that each path in the Source order example resolves. Check each ckf-1 must_have truth against the text. Write docs/history/cite-knowledge-first/reports/ckf-2.md with the test counts, the manifest result and one line per truth (met or not, with file:line). One commit.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test rule_index_parity --test pointer_integrity --test instruction_laws && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check && .bee/bin/bee onboard --repo-root . --json

truths: the report quotes fresh pass counts for rule_index_parity, pointer_integrity and instruction_laws
the report states each ckf-1 truth as met or not with a file:line

stages.reason: ckf-1 edits doctrine prose and runs the regen chain.
ckf-2: a separate checker re-runs the parity, pointer, manifest and onboard checks over ckf-1 and reads the rendered copies.
